items.title: Back-of-envelope: users se requests per second tak ka hisaab
items.one_idea: Turn a user count into requests per second with round numbers and open arithmetic: users x requests per user / 86,400, then multiply by a peak factor.
items.spoken_hook: Interviewer ने पूछा: रोज़ 10 लाख users हों, तो peak requests per second कैसे निकालोगे?
items.visual_idea: One fixed frame: phones feeding a server; calculation cards; day-long bar chart with a tall evening bar; request dots in the server box.
items.everyday_anchor: A railway ticket counter on a festival evening: the day's total tickets hides the 6 pm rush.
items.example: EXAMPLE (invented, labelled on screen): 10 lakh users, 20 requests per user per day, peak 3x, 0.2 s per request.
keywords: back of envelope estimation system design
